title: IssueTracker seam: canonical DTOs in src/core, re-export never redeclare
rationale: check-wire-types enforces any canonical name that carries a domain stem, so promoting DTOs into src/core/wire.ts forces every existing hand-copy to become a re-export in the same PR; keeping the seeds facade's status strings as unions additionally requires validating against the closed PLAN_STATUSES set at the boundary. Frozen line budgets on wire.ts leave no headroom for new re-export lines.

title: Capability-arm typing for IssueTracker ports
rationale: IssueTracker's base interface carries only getIssue/listIssueStatuses/closeIssue; optional arms live on separate interfaces, so ported call sites type deps as IssueTracker & Partial<MetadataCapableTracker/ScheduledIssueCapableTracker> and call the arm with ?. after checking the capability flag. resolveSeedTracker (src/runs/spawn/seed-extensions.ts) wraps a legacy seedsCli into SeedsTracker so callers not yet ported (plan-runs domain, warren-2d98) keep the post-dispatch metadata write.

name: warren-tracker-v1-conformance
description: warren-tracker/v1 conformance suite + FakeTracker (extensions/tracker-conformance/, warren-53ea): the suite is the falsification test a foreign tracker runs (bun run src/check.ts <url>); FakeTracker's --state-file mirror is the cross-process assertion seam, spawned as a subprocess by acceptance (layer seam forbids importing extensions/). Scenario 43 boots warren via lib/remote-tracker-server-entry.ts (BootServerOptions.issueTracker) with a connected RemoteTracker. The suite already caught two real leaks: (1) seeds-cli closeSeed never mapped sd's not-found exit to SeedNotFoundError, so SeedsTracker.closeIssue broke the issue_not_found taxonomy on the close path; (2) plan-run-wiring createCloseChildSeed hard-gated on project.hasSeeds, silently suppressing the coordinator-owned close for non-git-native trackers — capability checks must branch on tracker.capabilities.isGitNative, not on clone state.

name: seeds-read-tracker-port
description: HTTP read handlers for /projects/:id/seeds read through deps.issueTracker via requireTrackerProject (3-gate preamble: project 404 → hasSeeds → tracker-configured); plan reads gate on capabilities.supportsPlans with a loud ValidationError. resolveSeed in src/runs/reap/pr-context.ts uses tracker.getIssue with localPath-only TrackerContext. sd spawns are confined to src/seeds-cli/ + SeedsTracker, guarded by src/tracker/sd-spawn-containment.test.ts (warren-47b0).

name: jsonl-merge-driver
description: warren-9c90: id-keyed JSONL state files (.seeds/*.jsonl, .mulch/expertise/*.jsonl) must never use git merge=union — their writers rewrite rows in place, so union emits contradictory duplicate rows that git reports as a clean merge. The repo now registers merge=seeds-jsonl (scripts/merge-seeds-jsonl.ts), a 3-way ancestor-relative merge: per-field one-side-changed wins, array fields set-merge both sides' additions/removals vs ancestor, genuine conflicts exit non-zero. Driver config is per-clone via package.json prepare; GitHub server-side merges never run it — check:seeds-integrity is the only backstop there.
merge-seeds-jsonl driver on unresolvable conflict used to exit 1 without writing %A, leaving pure ours-content that silently resurrected the other side's closes when committed (PR #859).
resolution: warren-585f: driver now always writes a best-effort merge with git conflict markers on unresolvable rows; check-seeds-integrity rejects the marker file so it can't be committed silently.
